description: Convert a Word document to PDF in your browser — nothing is uploaded. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The Word document, base64-encoded; a data: URL prefix is stripped if present. A .docx is expected, and the older binary .doc is recognised from its bytes too. Up to 25 MB once decoded.

pageSize.description: document keeps the paper size and margins the file was written for. a4 or letter overrides them with that paper and fixed margins, which re-wraps every paragraph. Defaults to document.

name: word_to_pdf
title: Word to PDF
